# Stardust (SDUST)

> Stardust is a share sale on BNB Smart Chain. 3,000 shares of 2,000,000,000 SDUST each, cut from a fixed supply of 6,000,000,000,000. 500 shares are free (one per wallet), 2,500 are sold at 0.002 BNB each to anyone, with no per-wallet limit. Sale window: 2026-11-16 19:00 WIB to 2026-11-23 19:00 WIB.

Site: https://stardust-sdust.github.io/stardust/
Contract: 0x111c3a1D1d3Df9A0B9615dF8fC7276B3a2fAcAfd
Agent instructions: https://stardust-sdust.github.io/stardust/agent.md
Skill: https://stardust-sdust.github.io/stardust/skill.md

## Key facts

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (56)
- Token: Stardust (SDUST), 18 decimals, supply 6,000,000,000,000, immutable contract, no admin
- 1 share = 2,000,000,000 SDUST
- Free claim: claimFree(), 500 shares total, 1 per wallet, no conditions of any kind
- Buy: buy(n) with exactly n * 0.002 BNB, 2,500 shares total, open to anyone, no per-wallet cap
- Views: freeSold(), paidSold(), freeClaimed(address), PRICE, START, END, SHARE, FREE_CAP, PAID_CAP
- Transfers are unrestricted from the start; there is no pool and no trading tax
- After the window ends, anyone may call finalize() to burn the unsold reserve left in the contract
